svg.title: SegmentLab offline changepoint audit
svg.desc: Known shift and noise-misspecification examples. Separate observation and boundary probability panels, all points shown; posterior means are model conditional.
svg.text: SegmentLab | posterior confidence depends on the noise model
Offline exact finite-partition inference. Synthetic development examples, not event detection or real-data calibration.
Dots: all observations. Solid teal: posterior latent-mean average. Dashed gray: generating mean (not inferred).
Shared observation y[-3,5] and probability[0,1] scales. Marginal cut peaks are not a joint partition. No hidden thinning.
